# GitHub Workflow Scripts

Workflow scripts are designed to be executed using https://github.com/actions/github-script. Refer
to the existing workflows for usage examples.

No environment is required to edit the scripts; however, for convenience, JSDoc type-checking is
supported and can be enabled by the following procedure:

1. Install [Node.js](https://nodejs.org), either directly or using a version manager such
   as [NVM](https://www.nvmnode.com).
2. Run `npm i` in this directory.
